name: Acheron
tagline: The river of woe — and for a while, the hardest level in the game.

facts.note: Hosted by ryamu and co-hosted by Riot. The second of Riot's three hell-themed Top 1 levels.

theme.mood: Industrial hell. Dark brick, hanging chains and gears, red spikes, one cold cyan orb as the only relief. Chrome Roman capitals edged in red neon with a cyan chromatic split.

voice.why:
Acheron is the shortest level near the top of this list and it doesn't matter at all. Sixty-seven seconds, 72,808 attempts to verify, and for a while it sat at #1. The density is the point — there is no rest in it anywhere.

I also just love how it looks. Riot's hell trilogy has a consistent, genuinely oppressive visual language, and Acheron is the one where it clicked completely: brick, chain, gear, and that single cyan orb doing all the work of telling you something else exists.
